labctl.notes: exec: labctl exec nt4 "<cmd>" runs a command through cmd.exe in the guest and captures its stdout (exec_kind warpd_e, host client /root/gexec.py, GEXEC_HOST=exec_host). The agent is C:\WARPNET.EXE (streamhost/guest-agents/win9x/warpnet.c built -DWARP_PORT=7788), binding 0.0.0.0:7788; reached DIRECTLY over the retronet bridge at the guest IP 10.99.0.12:7788 (n0 is a tap on vmbr-rn, NOT slirp -- no hostfwd). It is RUNNING inside the golden and restarts from the All Users StartUp folder on a cold boot. Also true absolute vmmouse pointer. See docs/lab/retronet/ICQ-STATION-NT4.md.

# nt4 (VMID 89) — Windows NT 4.0 Workstation SP6a, accelerated ISA Cirrus
#   1024x768x65536 colors (16bpp), pcnet NIC on the retronet bridge vmbr-rn, audio off. VERBATIM launcher:
